description: This file defines the ImageRenderer class responsible for rendering images into RTF format within the MigraDoc document processing library. It handles image dimension calculations, source type detection, and byte stream rendering for various image formats.

classes.name: ImageRenderer
classes.description: A sealed class that renders images into RTF format, handling image attributes, dimensions, cropping, and source type detection.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Main method to render the image into RTF, managing paragraph and shape context.

methods.name: RenderImage
methods.description: Handles rendering of image description, attributes, and byte stream.

methods.name: StartImageDescription
methods.description: Begins the RTF description of the image, inline or block.

methods.name: EndImageDescription
methods.description: Ends the RTF description of the image.

methods.name: RenderImageAttributes
methods.description: Renders image-specific attributes such as size, fill, line, and source type.

methods.name: RenderSourceType
methods.description: Detects image file extension and writes corresponding RTF control for image type.

methods.name: RenderDimensionSettings
methods.description: Calculates and writes image scaling, width, and height in RTF.

methods.name: CalculateImageDimensions
methods.description: Loads the image, determines original and display dimensions, and handles errors.

methods.name: GetFileExtension
methods.description: Returns the file extension of the image, considering base64 data.

methods.name: RenderByteSeries
methods.description: Outputs the image byte data as a hex string into the RTF stream.

methods.name: GetShapeHeight
methods.description: Returns the scaled height of the image shape.

methods.name: GetShapeWidth
methods.description: Returns the scaled width of the image shape.

methods.name: RenderCropping
methods.description: Outputs cropping parameters for the image.
